traceDescription: SST k -> SST omega -> nut -> mu_eff -> diffusion coefficient -> aP/aN -> momentum RHS -> U*

mechanismProof.aP_formula: aP = sum(aN) + F_outward_sum (unrelaxed); aP_u = aP / alpha_u
